sources.title: Stephen162008/SaphraFgt: SaphraFgt-1.0 8B - GitHub
sources.snippet: SaphraFgt 1.0 8B is a fine-tuned Meta Llama 3.1 8B coding model developed by Seelam Reuben Stephen. It is optimized for frontend development, code generation, bug fixing, UI/UX implementation, code completion, and intelligent code editing while running efficiently with Ollama.
